newsitem.title: USA: Spiegel to use stock proceeds to expand Eddie Bauer.
newsitem.headline: Spiegel to use stock proceeds to expand Eddie Bauer.

text.p: Spiegel Inc. said Friday it will use $70 million in proceeds from issuance of 10.3 million shares of Class B voting common stock to fund capital needs, including the continued expansion of its Eddie Bauer subsidiary.

The speciality retailer's plans call for it to open up to 70 Eddie Bauer stores in North America in 1997 and double the number of Eddie Bauer Sportswear stores in North America over the next five years.
In total, Eddie Bauer currently operates 443 retail stores throughout the United States and Canada, including 348 Eddie Bauer Sportswear stores.
Separately, Spiegel said its net sales of $160.3 million for the four weeks ended Feb. 22 were down 9 percent from sales of $176.5 million a year ago.

The company also said that comparable-store sales, or sales from stores open at least a year, for Eddie Bauer decreased 4 percent for the four-week period, compared to a 19 percent increase reported for the same period last year.
Spiegel markets apparel and home furnishings through catalogues, more than 450 speciality retail stores and on the Internet.
